rule: O2 clade holds >= 50 % of the O1 derived P members

diagnosis.reading: All 50 O1 gains map to one O2 SOG (o2_same_sog). They are not re-called on O2 because the absences that support them are mostly missing on O2: 94/165 outgroup A calls are U on O2 (rescue:pending outside the O2 rescue pool -> U by PI rule) and 34/165 are P on O2 (different SOG/footprint). So non-recovery reflects O2 absence observability, not O1 orthology misassignment; the O2 rescue pool should be extended to these SOGs before reading this as an orthology check.
